toolsPreview.name: recall_risk
toolsPreview.description: Get the current complaint-velocity recall-risk signal for a tracked product/brand/model. Returns a 0-100 risk score, band, complaint velocity & acceleration, and severe-hazard share. This is a RISK SIGNAL from public complaint data, NOT an official recall or a claim the product is defective.
